integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a Front Wide Locked Shot frames a wide urban plaza or green park walkway under bright, soft natural daylight with warm morning sun, clear ground shadows giving spatial depth and a moderately blurred background. A team of senior and middle-aged adults in unified, coordinated bright athletic training wear stands in an orderly line, feet in a standard shoulder-width stance, knees softly bent, backs tall, shoulders and neck relaxed, eyes forward, their expressions relaxed, cheerful, and confident. From 0 to 4 seconds, feet stay planted while legs do light rhythmic bend-and-extend pulses; arms rise in unison to hip level with naturally bent elbows, wrists rotating gently, fingertips lightly closing, palms facing down, shoulder lines dipping slightly and shifting subtly side to side on the beat, the whole line perfectly unified. From 4 to 7.5 seconds, knees dip lightly to gather energy, arms rise slowly from the sides to chest level with palms meeting, and the group steps side to side in perfect sync with small, close steps — ball of the foot touching down first, heel settling after — arms extending and flowing toward the sides with soft elbow curves while waists and hips rotate slightly toward the direction of travel and torsos stay upright; they then settle firmly, arms opening to the sides with fingertips lifting slightly, the formation wider and clearly even. From 7.5 to 11 seconds, with light, small steps at an even tempo, the team converges toward the center, fingertips angled slightly inward while arms sweep in a circular embracing motion, palms turning upward with supple wrist rotation, closing into a compact circular formation with feet together, arms wrapping with elbows softly bent near the torso and upper bodies leaning slightly forward in a warm, welcoming shape. From 11 to 15 seconds, the team disperses outward from the center in an orderly, grounded manner, toes pointing outward, steps balanced between strength and ease; some members lightly raise their arms above shoulder height while others bring theirs back to waist level, with graceful wrist rotations and slight waist-and-hip turns on each step. At exactly second 15, the movement locks into a precise final pose: feet shoulder-width apart, a stable standing stance, arms raised lightly to chest level with palms facing outward. All formation transitions are fluid and continuous with no visible stops, fully expressing teamwork and collective vitality. Playback is at a subtle 0.8x slow motion to emphasize rhythmic precision and body-mechanics detail, with a medium depth of field keeping every row of the formation crisp and distinguishable.

overall_soundscape: Soft shuffling footsteps land in a steady rhythmic pattern on the paved plaza, accompanied by the light rustle of athletic fabric and synchronized breathing of the group. Faint distant city ambience and birdsong drift beneath the movement.

non_diegetic_music: An upbeat, steady percussion-driven track at a moderate tempo with light rhythmic accents matching the exercise beats, maintaining consistent energy and fading gently as the final pose locks.
